text:
maria-partnerships: quick sync — vendors pushed some dates. nvidia H100 firmware RC slipped ~2w, H200 still on track, amd MI300 driver freeze moved by a few days, gaudi team says image will land later than expected. we need to align marketplace announce windows + SI onramp and press embargo. proposed: staggered waves so we don't collide with partner press. thoughts?

alex-eng: can you ping vendor contacts and get exact gate dates? we need kernel/drivers + base image before we can start cert. also need to know if any microcode/firmware fixes will require rerun of perf benches.

sophie-marketing: from comms side — we can't do one big joint announcement if H100 is late. recommend two waves: wave A (H200 + B200) and wave B (H100 + MI300/Gaudi) 7-10 days later. keeps press ops manageable. also need embargo start time for each wave.

jordan-product: SI question — can integrators onboard with staged images? if gaudi image is late, some SIs will only be able to validate with our canary infra. i'll flag to partners and ask for availability windows.

chris-legal: make sure any embargo language with vendors covers changes to announce windows and delay clauses. if we publish a joint date and it slips, we need clear comms playbook to avoid breach. i'll draft a short addendum.

maria-partnerships: action items I'm taking: 1) schedule vendor triage call tomorrow 09:30 PT 2) create a single checklist doc with per-vendor gate dates 3) propose two announce windows (TBD) and fallback policy (auto-fallback to compatible model variant)

alex-eng: ETA on lab images: H100 firmware RC -> Thu 12:00 PT; H200 final image -> Mon; MI300 driver RC -> next Tue; gaudi image -> +10 days from vendor note. i'll post smoke logs to the checklist when ready.

alex-eng: `smoke-run` summary: H200 PASS (batch=32 seq=2048), H100 flaky on continuous batching under load (investigating), MI300 single-node PASS, gaudi pending image.

sophie-marketing: thanks. i'll draft comms flows for Wave A and Wave B and include press ops handoffs. need embargo windows by EOD so we can reserve press brief slots.

jordan-product: reaching out to top three SI partners now, asking for 2 available dry-run weeks — will report back.

chris-legal: draft addendum attached to doc (will upload). also request vendor contact for embargo handshake doc.

deploy-bot: calendar-bot created event "Vendor Roadmap Consolidation" for 2026-03-25 09:30 PT. invite: @maria-partnerships @alex-eng @sophie-marketing @jordan-product @chris-legal.

maria-partnerships: perfect. if everyone can drop their gate dates and one-line risk note in the checklist before the call, we'll lock wave dates in the meeting. thanks all :thumbsup":
